_meta.candidate_desc: codec state caching, gated consumer crossfade, lookahead RETIRED — the streamer emits 25-frame chunks with no overlap and the worker posts each decode whole (no trim, no seam blend)
_meta.reference_desc: what ships today: codec state caching, gated consumer crossfade, lookahead 5 — 30-frame windows at stride 25, trimmed to the splice and cross-faded over 1024 samples
_meta.isolates: the 5-frame lookahead ONLY. Both arms carry codec state caching, chunk_size 25 and the same gated consumer crossfade, and BOTH ARMS OF EACH PAIR ARE DECODED FROM THE SAME TALKER RUN — identical wording, prosody and duration. The Story 20.4 seam blend is a DEPENDENT of the lookahead, not a second variable: with no lookahead there is no retained tail to blend.
_meta.control_desc: short enough to produce one chunk in BOTH geometries, so the two files are byte-identical. Any difference reported on this trial is a property of the listening, not of the change.
_meta.prediction: No audible difference on any trial. If anything is audible it should be at the END of a long utterance, where the residual flush splits differently. A listener hearing the candidate as WORSE AT THE INTERIOR SEAMS falsifies the diagnosis: it would mean the Story 20.4 blend was doing real perceptual work under carried state, and the retirement has to be reverted.
_meta.variance_note: Within a pair there is no take-to-take variance to average over: the two files are the same take decoded two ways. The second take samples the CONTENT lottery, not arm variance.
